description.zh:
设备ID列表。可调用[QueryDevice](~~69905~~)接口查询设备ID。

> 单次调用最多可填写20个设备ID。
description.en:
The list of Device IDs. You can call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) API to query Device IDs.

> You can specify up to 20 Device IDs in a single invocation.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances. Pass this parameter for Enterprise instances.

title.zh: 批量获取网关或设备绑定到边缘实例的状态
title.en: Batch Query the Status of Gateways or Devices Attached to an Edge Instance

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Condition
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 5 queries per second (QPS) to invoke this API.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
